data: How many alignment mechanisms are there?

The caption describes two alignment mechanisms: one for "watashi katta" (I buy) and another for "akai honwo" (red book). The first mechanism aligns words that are dependency pairs in both the source and target parse trees. The second mechanism aligns words that are dependency pairs in the source side but are disconnected in the target side. Therefore, there are two alignment mechanisms described in the caption.
